notes.title: Lazy Galaxy 2 is Fully Released Today!
notes.content:
[b]Our next game, Lazy Galaxy 2, is launching now![/b] 
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27023349/91d437ddbda34bdf03a86c2fdaee7ee925d5249f.png[/img]
Lazy Galaxy 2 is an idle/clicker game with base-building and RTS elements. It stayed in early access for more than 6 months and on full release, you can experience these new features:
- mod support
- idle combat
- late-game upgrades and improvements
As well as other bug fixes/balancing and quality of life improvements.

Get the game here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1477950/Lazy_Galaxy_2/?utm_source=steam&utm_campaign=release_day
And as we are celebrating the Full Release of Lazy Galaxy 2, we are announcing discounts for all of our games!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27023349/07d79972df8ad4b704dde0c1059e0fa379b01f75.png[/img]

Thanks for playing our games and supporting us! Hope you'll enjoy Lazy Galaxy 2 as much as we do!

If you’d like to learn more about the game or want to hang out with devs and other Coldwild Games community members, you’re welcome to join us at: [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/coldwildgames]discord server.[/url]

Want to help us out? Consider spreading the word via Twitter, Reddit, etc. and leaving a review on Steam if you enjoyed the game!

Have a great rest of the week,
Elizabete and the rest of the Coldwild Games crew

notes.title: 1.2.0 patch and Android Release!
notes.content:
Thank you for your feedback! Per popular request, Luna's Fishing Garden is now available and playable on Android!

[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.coldwild.fishinggarden]You can get it on Google Play Store[/url]

Apart from that, here's the changelog for the last content update, 1.2.0:
[list]
[*]   Two new input modes for mouse and touchscreens.
[*]   Make it possible to cancel fishing using mouse or touchscreen.
[*]   Fix talk button remaining active after talking to NPC.
[*]   Fix tree and waterplant selection when erasing them using mouse
[*]   Other ajdustments for improving mouse/touchscreen only and small screen compatibility
[/list]

notes.title: V1.1 update and Nintendo Switch release!
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Luna's Fishing Garden and reporting a number of issues and possible UI improvements!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39248212/55d7c57f5ba195ef7f119cfe4f36d5077fc6565c.png[/img]

1.1.0 update adds the following quality of life improvements and bugfixes:
[olist]
[*]   - Fix duplicate transition between some menus
[*]   - Improve loading screens
[*]   - Fix formatting in German translation
[*]   - Prevent potential save coruption in case where game gets incorrectly closed (due to power loss, crash, ...) between changing options and autosave.
[*]   - Fix Kea sometimes getting stuck in wrong animation and not collecting any fruits.
[*]   - Fix initial language selection when starting the game for the first time.
[/olist]

The game is also getting a [b]Nintendo Switch release[/b] today! You can grab it [url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/lunas-fishing-garden-switch/]here[/url]

To celebrate this, we are placing the game on discount on Steam 🙂 Have a great week ahead of you and let us know if you have any questions!

notes.title: Luna's Fishing Garden 1.0.3 update
notes.content:
Hey!

Thank you for the overwhelming support of Luna's Fishing Garden. Based on the feedback, 1.0.3 patch is being released. We've adjusted the fishing chances a bit and fixed the case when fishing was dependent on the framerate (it should not have happened). The tuna should be working properly now :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39248212/12465e093ab0941f83cf425b332cd7d643e5dc5f.gif[/img]

Full changelog:
[list]
[*] Improve selection when removing plants and trees.
[*] Prevent [spoiler]"Hide and Seek"[/spoiler] ahcievement from triggering in situations it wasn't supposed to.
[*] Improved ultrawide screen support.
[*] Make fish order less random. Should prevent long streaks that don't contain a specific fish.
[*] Change behavior for some fish and prevent it from being affected by framerate. 
[*] French and Spanish translation improvements
[/list]

Let us know if there is anything else and thank you for playing!
Best,
Vladimir & Coldwild Games team

- Change behavior for some fish and prevent it from being affected by framerate.

notes.title: Luna's Fishing Garden - Devlog 3 and Demo Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Thank you for playing Luna's Fishing Garden demo over the Game Festival! The feedback you provided has been insanely helpful and we've already been implementing improvements that you've mentioned during Steam discussions.

Here's a small summary devlog:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9kFGQiDDAXk

We've pushed the demo with some UI/UX adjustments: 
[list]
[*] "sell" option does not sell quest items anymore
[*] fishing spot now shows all the fishes that can be caught (as soon as you encountered one)
[*] improved fog visuals
[*] multiple various fixes
[/list]

The demo is going to be available for at least one more week. Thank you very much and I look forward to the final release!
Best,
Vladimir

tags.bug: "sell" option does not sell quest items anymore

tags.feature: fishing spot now shows all the fishes that can be caught (as soon as you encountered one)

notes.title: Demo update, one more livestream!
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Luna's Fishing Garden and leaving your feedback, be it on Twitter, Facebook, here or on our discord channel.

We've adjusted some things as fast as we could, so the new version of the demo is available today:
[list]
[*] Some font changes to make the game-fonts more aligned
[*] Can no longer build buildings in the fog
[*] Rework dialog choice window
[*] Add exclamation marker to NPCs that have something to say to you
[*] Fishing animation bugfix
[*] Quest pending item display changed
[*] Camera transition adjustments
[*] Some more minor details
[/list]

In case you want to talk again, you can meet me on livesteam again at 17:00 UTC +2 on Saturday, February 6th.  Do let me know if you have any comments or questions!
Best,
Vladimir

tags.feature: Add exclamation marker to NPCs that have something to say to you

tags.balance_change: Can no longer build buildings in the fog
